name: Zion
source:
A part-timer who works at Banjul Café. Though he may look like your every day pretty boy, there are rumours of him being a genius harpist.

Having known Hobin for a long time, the two are almost like a family. Due to Zion's babyface, his age is often misunderstood despite him being a year older than Eri.

Likes: Playing the harp, tea leaves
Dislikes: Rude customers

[From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
